user_goal: I want to see which rules are active
preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it on Nov 14
steps: Open Memory → Rules
In Settings use Assistant rules → Open Rules
expected: Nudge, card statement and bill rules are on at 3 days and the goal pace rule is on
Regular-cost increase and Safe to spend rules are off
Open Rules opens /memory?tab=rules

action: Change the card statement lead time

preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it on Nov 14

Reload
Attempt 0 and 31 days
expected: The rule reads Flag a card statement up to 7 days ahead
The out-of-range values are refused and Activity has one rule change for the accepted value

action: Change and turn off the bill lead time

preconditions: Fresh Ben Try it on Nov 14

Reload then turn it off and save
expected: The bill rule holds 30 days until turned off
The card statement rule stays at 3 days

expected: The rule stays on at 25% and the invalid percentage does not save

Tap No on the rule offer and check Memory → Rules
expected: The offer disappears
The Safe to spend rule stays off

action: Turn off an older nudge threshold
user_goal: I want to keep control over my migrated setting
preconditions: The household had a 45-day nudge setting and a saved reader correction before migration 0028
steps: Check Rules for the 45-day threshold and reread a bill from the same biller
Clear On and save with the Days editor blank
Attempt to turn it on with Days blank and at 45, then use 30
expected: 45 days stays visible in the sentence and the blank editor explains the current limit
The reader still applies the saved biller correction
The old value can be turned off as-is. Turning it on requires a valid new number and 30 saves.

action: Refuse unauthenticated or cross-origin rule writes
user_goal: I want only my signed-in household to change rules
steps: POST /api/rules without a household session
Repeat with a valid session and an unrelated Origin
expected: The first request is refused with 401 and the second with 403
No rule or Activity row changes

action: Enforce the household rule write limit
user_goal: I want repeated requests bounded per household
preconditions: A household session with a fresh rate-limit window
steps: Send 21 valid same-origin rule saves in one minute
expected: The 21st request is refused with 429
The limit is scoped to that household

action: Initialize standing rules for a household created by older code

preconditions: A household created by the older app after the migration, with zero standing rule rows
steps: Open Memory → Rules
Reload and check Activity
expected: All six defaults appear on both visits
Activity contains one Default standing rules added row
